Good morning! **Peter** here, with a small point of _pride_ to share before we
get to the harrowing news of the day. I just learned that an essay I
[wrote](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/03/23/opinion/hooters-gay-family.html)
for the _New York Times_ about (of all things)
[Hooters](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hooters) is now being taught at
Harvard. Yes, you read that right. Students at the _" school in Cambridge"
_are assigned to review the piece as part of a freshman writing section. AI,
disinformation, illiteracy, and the general _TikTokification_ of American
culture may be weighing on journalism, but the craft persists!

Kaden Rummler will never properly see again.

He will never get to watch the sunrise as most of us do. He will never fully
glimpse the sight of rolling waves or falling leaves. He will never bear
witness to the faces of his future children as he deserves.

On Friday, the 21-year-old was
[shot](https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/demonstrator-injured-after-federal-
agent-fired-projectile-close-129187574) in the face at point-blank range at an
anti-ICE protest and nearly left permanently blind.

"**You 're going to lose your eye**," federal agents
[reportedly](https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2026-01-13/socal-
protester-permanently-blinded-by-dhs-agent-family-says) mocked him as he lay
bleeding on the ground.

[Video](https://x.com/Mollyploofkins/status/2011266612192842048) of the
incident shows Rummler sprinting to assist a fellow protester in Santa Ana,
California, before an officer fires a less-lethal round just inches from his
nose. Rummler immediately collapses, his face covered in blood. A DHS goon
then drags him like a ragdoll from the assembled crowd by the hood of his
sweatshirt.

Rummler's aunt
[reports](https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2026-01-13/socal-protester-
permanently-blinded-by-dhs-agent-family-says) he has a fractured skull, shards
of metal and glass in both of his eyes, and almost certainly would have died
if not for the extensive surgery he underwent soon after the shooting.

This all took place, I must remind you, less than a week after Jonathan Ross
riddled Renee Nicole Good's face with three bullets - an action that a mere
36% of Americans, according to a [Data for Progress poll conducted for
](https://zeteo.com/p/ice-renee-nicole-good-murder-poll-data-for-
progress)**[Zeteo](https://zeteo.com/p/ice-renee-nicole-good-murder-poll-data-
for-progress)** , consider justified.
